title: agropyron pauciflorum subsp. teslinense
intro: Agropyron pauciflorum subsp. teslinense, commonly known as Teslin wheatgrass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the genus Agropyron. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve antioxidant defenses in the body. The therapeutic actions of Teslin wheatgrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, and may provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Teslin wheatgrass, such as avenanthramides, may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and cardiovascular protective effects.
